t: This is Curlicue, a sculpture by William Pye. Pye is a British sculptor, born in 1938, and he is known particularly for his water sculptures. That is worth keeping in mind as you look at this piece, since his reputation rests on shaping form and movement, often with water. The name suggests a decorative curl or twist, so see whether you can pick out that curving shape as you walk around it.
